name: Türkiye
tagline: English-taught degrees in Istanbul, Ankara and Kayseri; IB minimums run from 24 to 36
summary: Türkiye's English-taught degrees are mostly at private foundation universities in Istanbul and Ankara, plus public Boğaziçi and Abdullah Gül. International applicants apply to each university directly; each sets its own IB Diploma minimum, from 24 at Bahçeşehir to 36 at Boğaziçi. Several say IB Course Results cannot be used, and every registration needs a Turkish high-school equivalency certificate.
whyConsider: Seven of the nine universities here state that their undergraduate teaching is mostly or wholly in English; Sabancı, TED and Abdullah Gül say their degrees are fully English.
Published tuition ranges widely: USD 1,400-2,000 a year at Abdullah Gül (2026-27), USD 8,000-10,000 at Boğaziçi, and USD 36,500 at Sabancı before scholarships.
Several universities accept predicted IB grades for a first application (Koç, Bahçeşehir); Bilkent and Boğaziçi state or imply that results are needed.
watchOuts: No university here has published Fall 2027 application dates. The 2026 windows are recorded as last year's: for example Koç 2 Mar-31 May (late to 15 Jul), Boğaziçi 6 Apr-5 Jun, Bilkent 2 Feb-12 Jul, Sabancı to 28 Aug.
IB minimums differ: Bahçeşehir 24 (USA page), Bilkent 28, Sabancı 28, TED 29, Boğaziçi 36, Koç 33-41 by college. Abdullah Gül's 2026-27 approved list does not name the IB.
Koç states that YÖK rules do not allow IB certificates (Course Results) as an entry qualification. No university here publishes a Course Results route.
Registration needs a Turkish high-school equivalency certificate (denklik); meeting a university's IB minimum does not guarantee it. Turkish citizens and some dual citizens follow different rules.
Law at Koç, Boğaziçi and Bahçeşehir and some other degrees need Turkish. TOBB ETÜ describes its teaching as 70% Turkish and 30% English, so no English-taught degree is confirmed there.
Istanbul Bilgi University could not be reached during research, so its record is still an outline.
